title: Right F119 6-Stage High-Pressure Compressor
summary: Six-stage axial high-pressure compressor driven by the single-stage HP turbine to achieve high overall pressure ratio for supercruise.
role: Raises core air pressure and temperature prior to fuel injection in the annular combustor.
materials: Titanium and nickel-base superalloy integrally bladed rotors.
